text:
Tara Nguyen: Quick check — next release train falls over Thanksgiving week. Thinking we should move the cutoff earlier to avoid holiday chaos. Proposal: cutoff Mon Nov 20 17:00 PT, branch freeze Mon-Tue for final validation. React with :thumbsup: if ok or :confused: if not.

Leo Park: +1 to moving it earlier. On-call overlap is light that week so we can do final canary Tue morning. Will schedule rollback window too. 

Anika Bose: Heads-up: some of my changelog entries are pending review (PR linked). Can we nudge folks to update changelog files? Maybe an automated reminder 48h before cutoff.

Samir Patel: I'm +1. Quick note — I have two open PRs that need reviews: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/842 and https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/559. @Leo can you take one? @Maria can you do the console one?

Maria Lopez: Yep I can review console PR tonight. Also we need to ensure the release notes editor has the 'Breaking changes' section enabled for this cycle.

deploy-bot: CI summary — infra/pull/842: all checks passing. console/pull/559: flaky e2e on staging, rerunning.

Tara Nguyen: Thanks. Draft branch-freeze checklist below — please skim and call out missing items.

``` 
- Announce freeze in #eng and #product 48h before cutoff
- Tag all pending PRs with `release/next` label
- Run full canary against dedicated pool Tue 09:00 PT
- Ensure changelog entries in /RELEASE_NOTES/ are reviewed
- Validate infra migrations on staging w/ 2x parallel traffic
- Prepare rollback playbook and on-call contacts
- Push final release notes draft to /docs/releases/ and ping PM
```

Anika Bose: Suggest adding "verify monitoring alerts for increased latency" to checklist.

Leo Park: I'll take the rollback playbook. Samir — can you handle the canary run and confirm metrics capture?

Samir Patel: Yep, I'll run the canary and post the metrics link. Planning to start at Tue 09:00 PT.

Maria Lopez: I'll finish console PR and the release notes draft by EOD tomorrow.

Tara Nguyen: Cool. If no objections by 24h, we'll set cutoff to Mon Nov 20 17:00 PT. Please add blockers now. :thumbsup:

(Decision pending: current reactions — :thumbsup: 4, :confused: 0)
